top_signals.title: Fed Rate-Hike Bets Sink Global Bonds, Oil Gains: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Global bonds fell, pushing yields to multi-decade highs, as concern over quicker inflation boosted bets on a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike this month. Oil climbed as geopolitical tensions flared.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: US Army secretary resigns after tension with Pete Hegseth
top_signals.summary: Dan Driscoll latest senior military figure to quit, leaving a vacuum at top of the American armed forces
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
